breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the incorrect claim that principal directions remain aligned with the original axes and that principal stresses are simply σx and 0. Instead, it explicitly says to compute principal stresses from the full plane stress state including nonzero shear stress, which matches the ground truth intent.
